title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Conservative perfect-gas state conversion and Euler-state calculations are identifiable in common/gas_model.hpp.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: A CGNS reader, mesh structures, and geometry routines are submitted, but no build or production mesh result verifies them.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: A first-order face residual loop exists, but it uses local-index checks against global face indices and is not validated by a delivered case.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Rusanov flux is called in residual.cpp; no separate entropy-fix implementation or result validation is evident.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Farfield, slip-wall, and no-slip adiabatic branches appear in residual.cpp, without output evidence of correct boundary behavior.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: reconstruct_faces is entirely no-op and compute_residual uses first-order face states.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: apply_limiter is entirely no-op; only an ad hoc state reset/check appears in the point update.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: viscous_flux returns an all-zero state and is not integrated into the residual, so laminar viscous capability is not implemented.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: steady_march contains a CFL-ramped point-implicit/diagonal update, but no completed steady result verifies convergence or correctness.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: main.cpp prints that the transient solver is not implemented; no BDF2 outer loop is committed.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS distribution and nonblocking MPI scaffolding exist, but neighbor data are placeholders and no scalability evidence was submitted.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
